drk.text: Iwset, the nation across the strait from Jehesic, is ruled by Lord Peemel, who claims that the city's sigil is the key to the Tomb of the Seven Martyrs, and Tavora smuggles the infant Yunnie away to Shingol to save him from Peemel's rage.
Peemel proposes war on Jehesic after Edara refuses his hand, and he tasks Maeveen and Vervamon with finding the Sigil of Iwset.
Digody assassinates Peemel after he abducts Edara, and Apepei kills Digody, and when Yunnie refuses the throne and smashes the city's sigil, the war ends with Edara and Apepei left to rule.
